feature: Pick several zooms and change or delete them together
summary: Shift or Command click adds zoom bars to the pick, a click on the Zoom lane's label picks every zoom on it, and the panel, the bar's right-click menu and Clip > Zoom rows then change or delete all of them in one undo step.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open a recording, add four zooms (playhead on the clip, right-click it, Add Zoom). Walk: Scripts/playtest/pick-several-zooms-walk.json.

try.do: Click one zoom bar, then Shift click a second and Command click a third.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: In the panel's Zoom section, pick 0.3s from Ease In.
Press Command Z, then Command Shift Z.
Click the word Zoom at the left of the Zoom lane.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click one bar, Shift click another, press Delete.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Command Z, click the Zoom label, right-click any bar and choose Delete Zoom.

evaluate: With three picked, does Ease In saying Mixed tell you what you need, and is one pick from it setting all three what you expected?
Is clicking the word Zoom on the left an obvious enough way to pick the whole row, or would you look for it somewhere else?
With several picked the picture shows the clip's own frame and handles instead of a zoom box. Is that the right thing to see?
Do the picked bars read clearly as picked, and as separate bars, when they sit side by side?
rough: With several zooms picked the canvas shows no zoom box: it shows the picture as it plays at the playhead, with the clip's own outline and handles back, so a press there moves the clip. Pick one zoom again to get its box.
Dragging one bar of several picked carries only that bar; moving the group together is folded into dragging-a-box-on-the-timeline-picks-everything.
There is no curve row yet because zooms have no curve; when they get one it joins the shared rows (folded into every-transition-can-be-picked-from-presets-and).
A pick stays on one recording: Shift click on a zoom on another clip starts a new pick there.
Follow Cursor when mixed shows the word Mixed beside a dimmed switch; turning it on reaches every picked zoom whose recording kept the pointer.
No mock covers the Zoom lane, so there is no mock frame to set it beside.
